data: In the En-Vi plot, what is the maximum valid loss in y-axis?

The question asks for the maximum valid loss in the y-axis of the En-Vi plot. From the caption, we know that the figure shows convergence curves of LayerNorm-simple and DetachNorm on two translation datasets. The En-Vi plot is one of these two plots. 

Looking at the En-Vi plot, the y-axis represents the valid loss. The blue line (DetachNorm) and the red line (LayerNorm-simple) both start at approximately 6.5 and decrease over time. The maximum valid loss appears to be around 6.5, which is the starting point of both lines. Therefore, the maximum valid loss in the y-axis of the En-Vi plot is approximately 6.5.
